يبتلعون (form VIII)
# يَبْتَلِعُونَ (yabtaliʕūna) /jab.ta.li.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# يُبْتَلَعُونَ (yubtalaʕūna) /jub.ta.la.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
